At5 demonstrations and1024 updates,pi Normal heldout17.367deg is close to the RAW small head16.605deg. The large r14 backend gap included optimization budget effects; current data do not establish inherent pi inability to use RAW tokens.
RAW3-demo last training RMS reaches0.645deg, but validation-selected Normal heldout remains19.017deg. Strong memorization is compatible with inadequate task generalization.

Native vision beats RAW with identical heads and budgets, especially5-demo Normal13.581 versus16.605deg; acquisition/pretraining differences prevent assigning this gap uniquely to RAW format or encoder architecture.
Matched nonlinear state-only readout beats both visual readouts on heldout data. Incremental visual task benefit remains unestablished even for native vision under this head/data regime.
Some5-demo RAW/native final training checkpoints worsen after512 updates; best validation checkpoints preserve better candidates. Late optimization is nonmonotonic.
All119 current state/action windows and357 RAW frames independently matched t/current and t+1..t+50; no future-state input or hidden position input was used.
interpretation: Evidence supports both bounded optimization insufficiency and limited data/task generalization. It does not establish an architectural hard failure of the RAW encoder. The visual-state readout/data regime also needs attention.
limits: pretraining and acquisition differ;not isolated architecture/RAW-format causality
Only frozen-representation readout/pi adaptation was extended. Encoder representation training itself was not extended; cannot rule out inadequate encoder training.
Native upstream pretraining/task-data exposure was not matched or fully audited against these heldout source episodes.
State-only uses identical nominal head tensors with zero image slots, hence differs in effective active input degrees of freedom.
Constant learning rates were held fixed. Some5-demo visual last checkpoints regress late; these runs do not establish fully tuned convergence.
Fixed validation-selected checkpoints and final-step checkpoints are both retained; test results never selected continuation or weights.
next_priorities: Use a strong measured-state action predictor as a fixed baseline, then test whether a controlled visual residual improves heldout predictions without degrading that baseline.
Separate encoder training adequacy from architecture using a separately budgeted representation-training study if stronger RAW-specific causal attribution is needed.
Expand independent task-relevant scene/initial-pose variation;3vs5 cannot establish data scaling saturation.
